findings.friction_name: persona abandoned the upgrade-plan task past its patience threshold
findings.narrative: free-tier-user reached step 11 via the direct upgrade-plan flow; willing-to-pay-user reached the identical abandonment point via a different retry path with a different simulated page state. Despite the differing DOM/path state, both terminal frictions share the identical fixed-sentinel target_element_identifier (F149, computed only from step=11, never from either persona's rendered DOM) and the identical designated patience-abandonment heuristic_tag (F150, drawn from the heuristic-set config, not narrative-derived) — so the two independently-authored records correctly merge into one finding at convergence_tier=2 (CR3-5), the exact corroboration signal the 3-persona architecture (F16/N5) exists to produce for the friction class that most needs it.
